author: Anne-alm

title: good app but—
body:
I like this app because I like the layout, and the colors. it’s very easy to use and cute, but my only comments are: 

why cant I edit my medium widgets with the habits of my choice? I tried rearranging them within the app but that didn’t work.

why do I have to have another subscription for the Growth Bundle when I have already subscribed to the premium version? this is so weird.
author: Hessa ALZ

title: Showing me tasks I set for other days
body:
I like the app because of the simplistic layout, can’t say it’s worth the price but it is alright.

The app allows you to set certain habits for specific days, but for some reason they stay displayed all the time with a subtitle saying “NOT TRACKED TODAY” and that is annoying!! I set them to specific days for a reason, I would like to only see them on the days I set.
author: Xav-Reviews

title: Went downhill
body: After the latest update the app lags a huge amount. Also the streak count is wrong - my long streak is now apparently broken. The app is too frustrating to use.

body: They recently offered 71% discount on their annual subscription. I have availed but still charged the full amount. I have sent an email but still no one is getting back to me. Really disappointed!
author: TungstenMinimalist

title: Small screen
body: So the app looks great and is nice but I’m using it on my iPad Pro and that makes the screen tiny on my iPad. This makes it very hard to use and it would be great if you made the screen compatible. Not for every model but a little bit of a bigger screen would be nice.

title: This Done App helps me get the job Done!
body: At last, the habit app I am happy to use. It’s so simple and intuitive. Great design and yeah, those tapping sounds give me a boost every time! Fantastic app, keep up the good work :)
